WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        b.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(b.double) AS average_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS b
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL
      AND p.bats <> ''
    GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        average_doubles / AVG(average_doubles) OVER () AS index_value
    FROM player_averages
),
compared AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        index_value,
        index_value - AVG(index_value) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT
    player_id,
    bats,
    average_doubles,
    index_value,
    difference
FROM compared
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
